keywords.primary: where does a plumber's bill go

instagram.caption:
She thought the plumber kept the whole $100. In his example, about $9 is left.
One plumbing shop owner says a customer held up a job because she believed the full price went in his pocket. He explained where the money goes, and she approved the work at the price first quoted.
In his example of a one-truck shop run from home: about $41 of every $100 pays the tech, $16 the office help, $8 the truck, $20 rules, phones, bank fees and the accountant, $6 insurance and the home office. Count the cost of a shop and he says it is under $2. Rounded, and he says every company's numbers differ.
Fair price, or still too much?
Send this to whoever calls it all profit.
Source: PHC Pros, Contractor Profit Advantage column, Mar 1, 2022. It is the columnist's own account and his own example budget.
